title: fix(console): Change Owner's queue target offers the queues an app declares
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBDHJBvzScLgkhKgms97sNuU)_

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzhoBbwh8URjwQHde8v

Fixes #36807
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:在记录上点「更改负责人」并选「队列」时,除了原来可搜索的组织队列,下方新增一组「已安装应用声明的队列」,可以直接选中并把记录交给它。
- 为什么做:应用包声明的队列在共享规则、流程审批里都能选,唯独更改负责人选不到,这次补齐两种队列来源。
- 出错会怎样:声明队列读取失败时这一组不显示,原有组织队列的搜索与选择照常;改动只在前端对话框,可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

The Change Owner dialog's queue target now offers both queue sources ADR-0142 D1 names.

- **Design chosen: a declared-queue group beside the `sys_queue` lookup, with the lookup told to leave declared names out.** The shared lookup widget draws static `options` only when it has no data source, so declared queues cannot be fed into it without a widget change (and the widget is out of this card's surface). The dialog therefore reads the declared queues (the `queue` metadata type, `GET /api/v1/meta/queue`, through the console metadata store's `ensureType('queue')`, the same reader `RecipientPickerField` uses), builds them with `mergeQueueCandidates`, and draws them as radio choices labelled with `queueCandidateLabel` under a new legend ("Or a queue an installed app declares"). The `sys_queue` lookup keeps its server search and paging untouched; when declared queues exist it carries `lookupFilters: [{ field: 'name', operator: 'notIn', value: DECLARED_NAMES }]`, so a `sys_queue` row sharing a declared name is never offered. That gives the server's registry-first rule on the client: each name is offered once, and the declared queue is the one shown. Either choice commits the queue's `name`, which is what the endpoint's `queue` takes.
- Why this over the alternatives: a wrapper data source that splices declared rows into the lookup's pages would need to copy the widget's query shapes (search, recents `$in`, hydration) and would break with them. A typed-term filter over the declared list would need the widget to expose its search term. The group plus the `notIn` filter uses only the widget's declared `lookupFilters` contract, which already reaches the list query, the search and the recents rail.
- The declared read starts only once the queue target is shown. It does not hold up the lookup. A failed read contributes nothing (the store answers a failure with no items, and a rejected read is caught too), so no group is drawn and the lookup runs unfiltered.
- `@object-ui/i18n`: one new key, `console.changeOwner.declaredQueues`, added to all 11 locale packs (key parity kept). zh-Hant is regenerated from zh-Hans by `gen:zh-hant`.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, `@object-ui/i18n` patch. `@object-ui/fields` is not touched (no helper export was needed).

## Tests

Tests: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/changeOwner-35403.test.tsx` (new describe "the queue target offers the queues an app declares beside sys_queue"), the `packages/app-shell/` and `packages/i18n/` suites, and `type-check` of both packages. The readings are in the Verification section.

New pins, all against the real lazy `lookup` widget and a `MetadataCtx` store:
- one record: a declared queue is offered, picked, and `data.changeOwner` is called with `{ queue: 'escalations' }`;
- a list: a declared queue is picked and `data.changeOwnerMany` is called with `{ queue: 'support_desk' }`;
- a plain `sys_queue` row is still offered by the lookup, can be picked, and is sent by its name, and no declared radio stays checked beside it;
- a declared queue and a same-named `sys_queue` row are offered once, declared wins: every `sys_queue` read the lookup sends carries the `$nin` of the declared names (in the object form for the list query and the array form for the recents rail), the row is not drawn, and the declared label appears exactly once;
- a failed declared read draws no group, no read carries `$nin`, and the lookup's row is picked and sent;
- nothing declared is read until the queue target is shown.

The existing objectstack#36395 pins (server search, no read until opened, the 201st queue found by search) pass unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- Card acceptance: "A pin in which a package-declared queue appears in the Change Owner queue tab and can be picked. The owner write then names that queue." The first two pins above cover it. "A plain `sys_queue` row is still offered as today." The third pin covers it. The collision pin is the one this order added.
- Whether the server checks that a queue name exists is a separate card (#36262, the server-side check of a queue target). It is out of scope here.
- Not browser-verified in a running Console. The pins drive the real lookup widget in jsdom.

## Verification

Two-minute check: in a showcase Console whose packages declare a queue, open a record on an object with the queue column, click Change Owner, and pick "A queue". The declared queues are listed under the lookup. Pick one and submit. The record's owner becomes that queue's name.

All readings were taken at head `973f17e627d` (after merging `origin/main` at `370e14d8a01`, which brings in #36863's lookup change).

<details><summary>Tests (local, under the shared verify lock)</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/changeOwner-35403.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.bulkChangeOwnerReach-35403.test.tsx packages/i18n/` gave `VERDICT command-exit 0`, `Test Files 111 passed (111)` and `Tests 2065 passed | 13 skipped (2078)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check && pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) gave `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Declared narrowing: the whole `packages/app-shell/` suite held the shared lock for more than 30 minutes and was stopped so it did not block other agents. Locally, the run covered the two app-shell files that test Change Owner. CI `Test UI` runs the full suite.
- zh-Hant was regenerated with `gen:zh-hant` after `zh-hant-generated.test.ts` flagged the hand-written value.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (one-off, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to the HEAD blob each time)</summary>

- Drop the `notIn` lookup filter (`? { lookupFilters: … }` replaced by `? {}`): the mutation landed (anchor 1 to 0). 1 test went red, "a declared queue and a sys_queue row of the same name are offered once: the declared one wins". After the restore, the blob equals HEAD `155ea687e64b` and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- Never read the declared queues (the effect returns early, marker `ABLATION_NO_DECLARED_READ`): the mutation landed. 4 tests went red: one record, list, plain row (it waits on the group) and same name. After the restore, the blob equals HEAD. The first attempt used a bare `return;` replacement, and the tool refused it as a no-op (the replacement count did not rise). It was rerun with the marker.
- The test imports the dialog from source (`./ChangeOwnerDialog`), so no dist rebuild was involved.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 41 derived families. 27 were run locally and exited 0, among them `check:nul-bytes`, `check:adr-0087-registration`, `check:changeset-no-major`, `check:empty-changeset`, `check:sdui-manifest` and `check:changeset-gate-self-tests`. `check:comment-mask-corpus` and `check:query-options-erasure` hit a local 240 s wrapper timeout (exit 124), so they are NOT MEASURED locally. The remaining heavy families (`vitest run scripts/`, type-check coverage and debt, engine-double, refd-timer, driver-memory census, published files, test-source alias, cross-package inputs, undeclared deps) are left to CI.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`: `VERDICT clean exit 0` against origin/main and 5 open PRs that share the locale packs.
- eslint on the two changed app-shell files: 0 errors (warnings are only `no-explicit-any` in the test file, the same as the existing cases).

</details>
